dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, jagged-edged high-intensity borders forming enclosed loops around low-intensity centers. A prominent 'O' shaped structure is located mid-flank with a non-uniform width border, exhibiting a sharp gradient transition from light peripheral pixels to a dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, punctate high-intensity pixel clusters dispersed between larger annuli, particularly concentrated along the ventral-lateral margin and toward the posterior extremity.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary triangular configuration is formed by connecting the centroids of the large mid-flank annulus, an anterior-dorsal annulus, and a posterior-mid-flank complex lattice structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive reticulated, net-like interconnected pattern on the posterior lateral flank where multiple light-colored borders merge into a continuous lattice structure.
